name: Love Spell: Aslan's Story
source:
Follow Luna's adventure through different worlds when she accidentally ends up chasing the mysterious pink-haired bartender named Aslan through a magical portal and straight into a parallel universe!

Meet new and old faces alike as you venture together with Philia, Aslan, and an adorable new little penguin named Merlow, Aslan's own familiar, as you set off on a quest to find a way to get you home.

Aslan's Route welcomes both new & old players from the main series as his story continues right from the end of the [url=https://vndb.org/v26749]original game[/url]'s prologue!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146520/Love_Spell_Aslans_Story/?utm_source=vndb]Steam[/url]]
translation:
跟隨Luna穿梭於不同世界的冒險吧！她意外追著神秘的粉紅頭髮的酒保Aslan穿過魔法傳送門，徑直來到一個平行宇宙！

你將與Philia、Aslan以及一隻可愛的新夥伴——Aslan的使魔小企鵝Merlow——結伴冒險，尋找回家的方法。

Aslan篇是本工作室首部作品的擴充篇章，故事緊接[url=https://vndb.org/v26749]《Love Spell: Written In The Stars》[/url]序章結尾，歡迎系列新老玩家體驗！

[來源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146520/Love_Spell_Aslans_Story/?utm_source=vndb]Steam[/url]]
